int_name: W CAMBRIA ST & N STILLMAN ST

result.summary: The image depicts a residential urban intersection with sidewalks but a complete lack of pedestrian crossing infrastructure. There are no marked crosswalks, curb ramps, or visible traffic control devices, creating a high-exposure environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked Intersection
hazards.description: No painted crosswalks or signage to indicate pedestrian right-of-way at the intersection.

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The curbs are vertical with no sloped transitions, creating a barrier for people with mobility aids or strollers.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: The roadway surface is cracked and patched, creating potential tripping hazards and uneven footing.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and left side of the roadway

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install zebra-striped crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian paths and alert drivers.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install directional curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces at all four corners of the intersection.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking near the intersection to improve sight lines between pedestrians and approaching vehicles.

result.summary: The street is a residential corridor with sidewalks but lacks any formal pedestrian crossing infrastructure or traffic calming measures. Parked vehicles on both sides of the narrow roadway create potential sightline obstructions for pedestrians attempting to cross.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Continuous street parking on both sides limits visibility between drivers and pedestrians attempting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbs throughout the street view.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: No designated crossing points are visible, forcing pedestrians to cross mid-block without protection or priority.

hazards.name: Degraded Road Surface
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven pavement can pose a trip hazard or affect vehicle handling.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks at intersections to define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at corners to shorten crossing distances and improve sightlines by moving pedestrians past parked cars.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Greenery
interventions.description: Add street trees to provide a buffer between pedestrians and traffic and naturally slow vehicle speeds.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features continuous sidewalks and a modern curb ramp with tactile paving at a residential corner. Safety is compromised by faded crosswalk markings and a blind corner created by the adjacent building's proximity to the street.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk markings are heavily worn and difficult for drivers to see.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the side street in the foreground

hazards.name: Blind Corner
hazards.description: The building on the corner is built to the sidewalk edge, limiting sightlines between pedestrians and turning vehicles.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with continental or ladder markings to increase visibility to motorists.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the intersection to improve sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and slow turning traffic.

hazards.name: Degraded Road Surface
